tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background behind cards and panels. Ink and slate text both read on it.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, tables, inputs, menus and dialogs. Ink, slate and brand text read on it.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and card borders. Decorative only: never the sole edge of an input or a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Input, checkbox and secondary-button borders. At least 3:1 on surface and bg in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body text and headings on bg, surface, brand-tint and the status tints.

tokens.name: slate
tokens.usage: Captions, hints and column headers on bg, surface and brand-tint.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Maalban Teal. Primary buttons, active menu item, links, selected borders. Text or icons on bg, surface and brand-tint. The one colour a dealer may replace.

tokens.name: brand-dark
tokens.usage: Deep Teal. Hover and pressed fill of brand, and headings placed on brand-tint.

tokens.name: brand-tint
tokens.usage: Mint. Selected rows and cards, soft panels. Ink, slate and brand-dark text read on it.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a brand fill.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Amber. Logo tape, highlights, warning borders. A fill only, never text or a thin mark on surface (2.2:1 in light).

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Dark Amber. Text and icons placed on an accent fill.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Money in: receipts, paid, in stock. Text on surface and bg. Fixed: dealers never change it.

tokens.name: success-tint
tokens.usage: Success banner and badge ground. Pair with ink text, not success text.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Money out: payables, errors, loss warnings, delete. Text on surface and bg, and the danger button fill. Fixed: dealers never change it.

tokens.name: danger-tint
tokens.usage: Error banner and badge ground. Pair with ink text, not danger text.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a danger fill.

tokens.name: warning-tint
tokens.usage: Warning banner and badge ground. Pair with warning-ink text.

tokens.name: warning-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons on warning-tint.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 3px solid, 2px offset. At least 3:1 on bg and surface in both themes.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Page titles on first-run and empty screens only.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default text on desktop. Use 15px minimum on mobile.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Hints, timestamps and column headers in slate.

styles.name: money
styles.usage: Every amount. PKR prefix, thousands separators, tabular figures, right-aligned in tables. Regular or semi-bold only.

styles.name: body-ur
styles.usage: Default Urdu text. Nastaliq reads small, so 18px with 2.0 leading.

styles.name: heading-ur
styles.usage: Urdu screen and section titles. Same weight and hierarchy as Latin, no decoration.

styles.name: label-ur
styles.usage: Urdu buttons, field labels and menu items.

styles.name: caption-ur
styles.usage: Urdu hints and column headers in slate.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, label-to-field gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between small controls and inline items.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Input horizontal padding, banner vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Button padding, table cell padding, gaps between fields.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding and gaps between cards.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between sections on a screen.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Screen margins on desktop.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Empty-state and first-run spacing.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Key caps and small tags.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, banners.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, tables and dialogs.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Badges.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Resting raised card. Use sparingly: borders carry most separation.

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers and dialogs only.

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Minimum height of every button, input and menu row (touch target).

tokens.name: control-lg
tokens.usage: Primary action on the invoice and payment screens.
